# Subsudo: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code 57aabd3cd0d2 · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Virtual fight club: record a shadow-boxing round with your phone or laptop camera, send it as a challenge, and climb the global and city rankings.
**Live:** https://subsudo.com · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/subsudo-challenge · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `subsudo/.claude/skills/subsudo/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py subsudo` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Engines stay JS** (`theme/assets/`): `ss-core.js` (window.SS: portraits SS.avatar, punch timeline, rating line, tale-of-the-tape bars, live score = mirror of `Boxing.score_round`, bell/thud/voice, music via `ark-music.js`, share/copy), `ss-face.js` (SS.AVATAR parts + SS.face SVG + bout damage), `ss-motion.js` (PhoneDetector, CameraDetector/MediaPipe, SS.recorder = the whole round flow). Python reaches them through `client_code/ss.py` (js()/py() JSON bridge, text helpers) and `Components/` Avatar, Place, Tags, Poster, Result, VsBars, Timeline, RatingLine, Recorder.
- **Recorder**: a page calls `self.recorder.start(on_keep, secs=, devices=, allow_secs=, keep_label=)`; the engine's Keep calls Python `on_keep(round_dict)` (a Promise in JS while the server call runs). On `{ok: False}` state.call toasts and the summary stays for another try. The component stops camera/motion/music on `hide`; pages call `recorder.stop()` when they swap to a result screen.
- **Engine -> Python toasts**: `startup.py` sets `window.SS_HOST.toast`; ss-core.js's `UI.toast`/`UI.busy`/`UI.initials` shim replaces the old core.js helpers.
- **Mail dot**: `Layouts/Shell` polls `unread_count` (60 s, and 1.2 s after a page change if 20 s passed); Pages/Mail calls `shell.set_unread(n)`. NavLink items carry `dot`.
- **Guest invites**: Pages/Invite keeps `guest_key` and leaves `claim` = {token, key} in browser storage (key prefix `subsudo.`, same as the JS version); Pages/Home claims it on the next visit.
- **Locker**: part names/colours come from `SS.AVATAR` (JS) so they match the drawing; `Fighters.AVATAR_PARTS` must keep the same counts. Rows update in place (`PartRow.show`) to keep keyboard focus.
- **Admin house fighter** is a DropDown of `HOUSE_FIGHTERS` (the JS version also allowed typing a new name).
- Recorder gear icon wrapper is `.rc-ic` (`.ic` is the icon-mask class). Athletic-tape rules (`.ss-h::after`) and poster shadows are deliberate (`design-ok`).
- Tests: `tools/ui/smoke.js` (every address guest/member/admin at 1280 + 390 px, plus one fast pad round: `SS.timeScale`, `SS.tapPad`).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
